post_result_disclosure.reason_selected: The completed binary reflections show that geometry can reverse requested-side depth and success asymmetry. A continuous, model-blind lateral intervention is required to estimate how the contrast changes with geometry rather than only whether it flips.

exact_prompts.left: Put the Rubik's cube to the left of the bowl.
exact_prompts.right: Put the Rubik's cube to the right of the bowl.

held_fixed_within_cohort: rubiks_cube full initial pose at the exact V3-B001 control fixture value
banana full initial pose at the exact V3-B001 control fixture value
bowl x, z, and source quaternion at the exact V3-B001 control fixture value
robot base, cameras, and all nonmovable geometry
prompt bytes and static-episode instruction controller
Cosmos3 Nano checkpoint revision and server repository revision
frozen 45-degree requested-relation cone and detached-release success predicate
environment and sampling seed within each seed-by-level LEFT/RIGHT pair

randomization.first_14_seed_rule: Use a deterministic cyclic Latin order over the 14 level-by-direction conditions so every condition occupies every execution ordinal exactly once across seeds 9500-9513.
randomization.seed_9514_rule: Order the 14 conditions by SHA-256 of vla_wam_language_steerability_v3:V3-B004:nano:seed9514:<level_id>:<relation>:order and record the keys.
randomization.lane_rule: Keep all 14 cells for one seed on one runtime lane.

model_blind_numeric_calibration.fixed_poses: Use the exact V3-B001 control positions and quaternion sources for rubiks_cube and banana, and the exact V3-B001 control bowl x, z, and quaternion source; vary only bowl robot-frame y.

dense_scan.grid_alignment: integer multiples of 0.01 m displacement about the exact V3-B001 control bowl y=0.12658219039440155 m
dense_scan.candidate_bounds: Compute from the live table support AABB after subtracting the bowl collision projection and a 0.02 m boundary headroom; do not hand-enter bounds from model outcomes.

candidate_pass_criteria.post_settle_orientation_differences: record as downstream physical mediators; do not silently gate or discard

seven_level_selection_rule.symmetry: Select the largest r on the 0.03 m grid for which all seven levels [y0-r, y0-2r/3, y0-r/3, y0, y0+r/3, y0+2r/3, y0+r] are dense-scan passing candidates, where y0 is the exact V3-B001 control bowl y=0.12658219039440155 m.
seven_level_selection_rule.tie_break: largest r only; no model-conditioned or outcome-conditioned choice
seven_level_selection_rule.failure_rule: If no r >= 0.09 m passes, fail closed. Do not narrow, shift, or respacing the levels after any model request.
seven_level_selection_rule.required_output: Persist and hash-bind exact poses, quaternions, seven ordered y levels, collision/table bounds, reset margins, all repeat measurements, renderer evidence, and source identities in model_blind_lateral_calibration_report.json before generating the 210-cell queue.

analysis_plan.inferential_unit: matched seed; the 105 seed-by-level pairs are repeated observations, not independent seeds

full_sample_primary.signed_offset: s[i,j,d] = signed_final_lateral_offset_m for every valid episode, including failures; positive is robot LEFT
full_sample_primary.dose_response: For each seed i, regress B[i,j] on the seven calibrated bowl-y levels. Report all 15 slopes, mean, median, 20,000-seed bootstrap 95% intervals, positive/negative/tie counts, and an exact two-sided sign test.
full_sample_primary.zero_crossing: Estimate and report only if the fitted crossing lies inside the calibrated support; never extrapolate.

binary_success_secondary.outputs: LEFT and RIGHT success counts and Wilson 95% intervals at each level; paired success_R-minus-success_L by seed and its within-seed slope
binary_success_secondary.claim_boundary: Nano is near binary ceiling, so success is secondary and may be insensitive.

analysis_plan.success_conditional_margin: At each level, include only seed pairs where both LEFT and RIGHT pass. Name realized n separately at every level; never mix unmatched successes or turn failures into zero.
analysis_plan.failure_taxonomy: Retain the frozen five-class outcome for every valid episode and report it by level and direction.
analysis_plan.missingness: No imputation. Infrastructure and partial attempts remain in a separate stream and are repaired only as the identical registered cell.

runtime_identity_requirement.fixed_observation_gate: At each named level, require an exact repeated LEFT response and a finite positive LEFT/RIGHT action and decoded-future difference under the same runtime.

prospective_neutrality_correction.reason: Centering the sweep at robot y=0 cannot preserve neutral starts over the preregistered minimum half-range; centering it at the exact pre-existing control bowl y can.

release_boundary.next_command_boundary: Run only the zero-model-request dense physical calibration. Do not start the Nano server or generate behavioral queue rows until the seven numeric levels and their calibration report are committed and hash-bound.
